components.title: **Academic Vocabulary Builder**
components.subtitle: Elevate your lexical power. Review these 10 high-yield verbal reasoning terms designed to boost comprehension.

components.title: Study Strategy
components.description: Look at the word on the front, recall its meaning, then tap the card to flip it over. Rate your internal recall before moving to the next term.

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time; transient, fleeting, or passing quickly.
Present, appearing, or found everywhere at once; omnipresent.
A harsh, discordant, and meaningless mixture of loud sounds.
Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood, behavior, or opinion.
Brisk, cheerful, and eager readiness to respond or act.
A feeling of listlessness, boredom, and dissatisfaction arising from lack of excitement.
Very attentive to detail, accuracy, and cleanliness; difficult to please.
Excessively talkative, especially on trivial or unimportant matters; wordy.
Not allowing fluid to pass through; completely unaffected or undisturbed by external forces.
Extremely wicked, villainous, or criminal in nature.
